svg.title: Lạc Long Quân and Âu Cơ
svg.desc: Paper-cut cover: on the left, a long friendly jade-green dragon with a flame-like red crest and curly gold whiskers rises out of blue sea waves. On the right, on green mountains, the fairy Âu Cơ stands smiling and waving, in a peach top and rose skirt, with a crown of white feathers and pink flowers in her long black hair. A white egret flies above her, and a golden sun with a many-pointed star shines between them.
